findings.message: happy-dom@15.11.7 is within the affected version range of three published CVEs: GHSA-37j7-fg3j-429f (critical, VM context escape / RCE, affects <20.0.0), GHSA-6q6h-j7hj-3r64 (high, unsanitized export names → code execution, affects >=15.10.0 <=20.8.7), GHSA-w4gp-fjgq-3q4g (high, fetch credential leak, affects <20.8.9). Package is a devDependency used only in vitest happy-dom test environment, not included in the production bundle.
findings.evidence: npm audit: 1 critical vulnerability, range <=20.8.8, happy-dom. Installed: 15.11.7. CVEs: GHSA-37j7-fg3j-429f, GHSA-6q6h-j7hj-3r64, GHSA-w4gp-fjgq-3q4g.
findings.suggested_action: Upgrade happy-dom to ^20.11.15 in devDependencies. This is a major-version bump (15.x → 20.x). Verify no breaking API changes in vitest.config.ts or app/__tests__/review-workspace.test.tsx before upgrading. The fix does not require changes to application source files.
